overview: Host John Petrella interviewed city council candidate Rick Caraviello regarding municipal zoning changes and the funding of a proposed new Medford High School.

items.title: Introduction and Candidate Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced candidate Rick Caraviello, who summarized his background as a former city councilor and community leader.

items.title: Municipal Zoning
items.summary: Richard Caraviello shared his perspective on city zoning, warning against rapid residential rezoning and advocating for smart commercial growth to build the tax base.

items.title: Medford High School and School Funding
items.summary: Richard Caraviello discussed the necessity of rebuilding or renovating the high school while cautioning about the financial impact of tax overrides on residents.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: John Petrella and Richard Caraviello concluded the program by encouraging residents to participate in early voting and the upcoming election.
